title: Notes:
description:
renders the currently selected beatmap in song select, synced to the preview audio timestamp.

mania only (std -> mania conversion is previewed approximately; taiko/catch show a notice).

scroll speed and visuals follow the map difficulty + selected mods + player skin served by tosu.
score, combo, accuracy and judgement are intentionally not drawn.

place this counter as an OBS browser source or in the tosu ingame overlay, then size/position it freely.
value: feel free to adjust this text. it does nothing.

title: Render Scale (%)
description: scales the playfield inside the counter window

title: Show In Song Select / Multiplayer
description: show the preview in song select and in multiplayer rooms (osu!stable matchSetup / selectMulti, lazer multi)

title: Auto Hide In Gameplay
description: hides the preview while playing; disable to keep it visible during play

title: Use Player Skin
description: on: use the currently selected player skin (including skin.ini mappings); key counts or elements the skin does not define fall back to the bundled default skin (蓝白砖皮). off: always use the bundled default skin

title: Lazer Skin File (.osk)
description: osu!lazer only: name of an .osk exported from lazer and copied into this counter's folder (e.g. My Skin.osk). empty = auto-try "<current skin name>.osk", player.osk, skin.osk

title: Mania Scroll Speed Override (0 = game)
description: 1 - 40, 0 uses the scroll speed reported by tosu

title: Playfield Opacity (0 - 1)
description: opacity of notes and playfield elements

title: FPS Limit (0 = unlimited)
description: cap the redraw rate (e.g. 60) if the ingame overlay stutters

title: Show Bar Lines
description: draw the map's measure lines (小节线) falling with the notes; timing-only maps with thousands of red lines and no hit objects are only visible through these

title: Force Upside Down (DDR)
description: notes rise from the bottom and the judgement line is mirrored; skins that already set [Mania] UpsideDown are flipped automatically, this forces it for skins that do not declare it
